notes: Two alternative illness-rate options are complete pairs; do not combine one option's GM with the other's STV.

sources.title: Recommended Human Health Recreational Ambient Water Quality Criteria or Swimming Advisories for Microcystins and Cylindrospermopsin
notes: A 10-day assessment period containing any concentration above the magnitude is an excursion; do not average concentrations over ten days.
EPA allows different state-selected implementations of assessment-period timing. Record the actual approved assessment-period rule rather than inventing an anchor.
A pattern of more than three excursions per recreation season recurring in more than one year is the stated pattern; the state chooses the upper-bound assessment years.
The advisory and water-quality-criterion uses are different applications.
